d: From India to France, governments are bracing for a weekend of protests as public anger spills onto the streets. In New Delhi, the opposition INDIA bloc is preparing a major rally over electoral roll revisions and allegations of voter deletions. France is set to hold nationwide demonstrations over the cost of living, wages and public services, while Albania, Israel and Indonesia are also set to witness anti-government protests. What is driving the unrest, and how are authorities preparing? Palki Sharma tells you.
